title: Guarantee direct Outcome delivery and archived report binding
rawUserRequest: Outcome按设计不止写入文件，还必须输出到当前对话；Outcome用于观察当前两个WI是否按需求实现，发现问题按对应WI处理。用户已授权调查并修复Outcome未输出、归档报告不一致及其对未来安装对象工程的模板入口影响；WI途中遇到问题优先在当前WI内解决，不无必要扩展新的WI。

preReviewWarnings: Review that an omitted or empty REPORT_LANGUAGE reaches the direct Outcome renderer while explicit locale selection remains unchanged.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Running make ai-finish for a governed task without REPORT_LANGUAGE supplies the en default locale and reaches the Outcome delivery path; explicit en, ja, and zh-CN values remain forwarded unchanged.
Every blocked or failed finish path persists the active blocked Outcome and prints the same Outcome plus human-benefit report to stdout before returning a nonzero status.

The archive transaction always regenerates .ai/cockpit/task_report.json and .ai/cockpit/task_report.md from the rewritten archived Outcome, including when no prior singleton report exists, and records those generated paths in the Summary.
Makefile and templates/make/Makefile.ai have equivalent default-language behavior so future installed adopter projects receive the same direct Outcome delivery contract.

The conversation-facing Outcome includes the canonical traffic-light emoji for every supported status: 🟢 for completed, 🟡 for conditional or human-confirmation states, and 🔴 for blocked or cancelled states.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: A governed finish can exit before it creates or prints an Outcome when the Makefile passes an empty report language, and archive transactions can leave the singleton human-benefit report absent or bound to stale evidence. This makes the result unavailable in the conversation and can fail downstream alignment checks.
constraints: Keep the existing Task Outcome schema, localized facts, and fail-closed finish behavior unchanged; add only the required visible traffic-light marker to the human-facing status line.
Do not rewrite historical archived evidence by hand; only use the canonical archive transaction.
Keep repository and future-adopter Makefile entrypoints behaviorally equivalent.
Keep the fix bounded to this Work Item and its regression tests.
intent.rationale: Bind a safe default locale at the portable Makefile boundary, retain direct stdout delivery from the persisted Outcome on failure, and make the archive transaction deterministically refresh the singleton report from the authoritative archived Outcome.

declaredIntent.summary: Guarantee that governed finish results are visible in the conversation and that archived Outcome and singleton review-report projections cannot drift, including for future installed adopters.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The command uses the default locale, persists a blocked Outcome, prints the direct Outcome report, and returns nonzero.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a Make dry-run and subprocess regression that omits REPORT_LANGUAGE and asserts the stdout Outcome boundary.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The exact locale is forwarded to ai_finish and the rendered report uses that locale.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run Makefile forwarding tests for en, ja, and zh-CN.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Both singleton report files are generated from the rewritten archived Outcome and declared in the Summary.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add an isolated archive transaction regression with absent prior report files.
